result.description:
SALTER BROTHERS HOSPITALITY RETREAT COMPANY NO. 2 PTY LTD  
  

Position  : Full-Time
Location : Blue Mountains NSW 2785
Salary    : $70,000 - $95,000 a year
  

Nestled on the edge of the Greater Blue Mountains National Park and Hunter Valley Wine Country is the Salter Brothers Hospitality collection of distinctive luxury accommodations and restaurants encapsulating heritage, indulgence and character at its best.
  
The five properties are unique to the Blue Mountains and Hunter Valley regions and provide an immersive journey through Australia’s most visited tourism destinations.
  
“Echoes Boutique Hotel and Restaurant / Hydro Majestic Hotel / Lilianfels Blue Mountains Resort and Spa / Parklands Country Gardens and Lodge / The Convent Hunter Valley / Spicer Guesthouse Hunter Valley"
  
Salter Brothers Hospitality Group is seeking an experienced Duty Manager/Hotel Manager to join their teams.
  
Task and Responsibilities:
Plan, coordinate and participate in all operational activities including food & beverage and front desk/reception activities to ensure all operational activities function smoothly.
Monitoring cost ratios across all operating departments and ensuring that the budgeted expenses are in line with the budget.
Provide ongoing staff training and review in accordance with all operational guidelines and SOPs.
Assist in setting up quality control measures and monitoring of all guest feedback for improvement to all services on the property including housekeeping.
Conducts weekly and daily meetings with all Front Office/F&B/ Housekeeping/Gardening staff to ensure all are properly brief of activities at the property and liaise with all other department heads regarding reservations, events and finance matters.
Recruit and provide induction for all new staff as required.
Handles guest complaints and queries tactfully to ensure guest satisfaction.
Maintains Front Office files and records as required by management.
Managing cash handling, credit card processing, and reconciliations
Overseeing the safety and security of guests, team members and hotel assets.
Ensure all OHS and Emergency procedures must be always adhered to.
  
Skills and Experience:
Relevant qualification in the hospitality industry
At least 2 years of relevant experience.
Proven management experience working in hospitality/customer service environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead a team and get results.
Exceptional organisation and problem-solving skills.
Excellent presentation and grooming standards.
Technical product knowledge in food and wine.
Understanding of budgets and forecasting.
Knowledge of CRO and end-of-day reconciliation procedures
Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
 
If you meet the above criteria please apply now, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
result.title: Duty Manager/Hotel Manager

result.description:
The Australian Automotive Group (AAG)
  
  
Position  : Full Time
Salar y    : $75,000 - $85,000 a year
Location : Sydney
  
  
The Australian Automotive Group (AAG) has evolved into an outstanding portfolio of automotive assets. The core of which is the six leading Ford dealerships in Sydney. The Ford portfolio has been complemented by the addition of Suzuki, Renault, Mitsubishi, Hyundai, Isuzu and Kia.
  
Australian Automotive Group is currently looking for experienced, motivated, and enthusiastic for ICT Support Technician to join their head office in Alexandria NSW.

Their dealerships in Sydney are: Brad Garlick Ford, Castle Hill Renault, City Ford Sydney, City Ford Rockdale, Cumberland Ford, Cumberland Suzuki, Power Ford, Titan Ford, Brookvale Mitsubishi, Ryde Hyundai, Castle Hill Isuzu Ute, Ryde Isuzu Ute, and Rockdale City Kia.
  
The role will involve the following:
Provide technical support to employees via phone, email, remote access, or onsite.
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and other IT equipment.
Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
Set up and manage user accounts, passwords, email accounts, and access permissions
Install, configure, and update operating systems and business applications.
Support dealership management systems
Maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, and network devices.
Assist with cybersecurity by applying software updates, antivirus protection, and security policies.
Assist with server maintenance, backup verification, and disaster recovery procedures.
Document IT procedures, troubleshooting guides, and system configurations.
Ensure compliance with company IT policies, cybersecurity standards, and data privacy requirements.
  
The successful candidate will need the following:
Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience
Relevant qualification
Strong knowledge and troubleshooting of Microsoft Windows and Service OS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Entra ID and Azure knowledge is highly regarded
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong customer service focus with the ability to support users of varying technical abilities.
Good organisational skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate documentation. 


If you think this role is right for you, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Valley Park Farm is a locally owned Victorian business. Our first farm was established in the heart of one of Australia’s most productive farming lands, the Goulburn Valley. Our three original sites are bordered by the Goulburn River on one side and Great Dividing Range on the other.

Expansion in 2012 saw the addition of a farm nestled amongst the rolling hills of the Strathbogie Ranges. An abundant fresh water natural spring carries life and nourishment to our free-range hens, where our farm began free range egg production in 2013.

We are seeking highly skilled and highly efficient Maintenance Engineer to join our team of professionals on a full-time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Work to verbal and/or written instructions provided by General Manager and Technical Manager
Ensure the efficient functioning of the Sanovo Grader Pro
Recommend and develop maintenance procedures, in accordance with operational requirements and technical specifications.
Regular scheduled maintenance programs to cover a wide range of Sanovo equipment, including all other equipment and building used in grading operation
Actively engage with training of nominated VPF maintenance staff to satisfy a high level of knowledge and capability with reference to operating and maintaining the Sanovo Grader pro and associated ancillary equipment.
Analyse operational/technical problems. Determine and report on appropriate courses of action
Ensures the implementation of Valley Park Farm Quality Policy and quality system.
Respond to and resolve emergency breakdown and repair requirements.
Perform preventative, general and emergency maintenance requirements.
Maintain inventory of supplies, tools, equipment or material to ensure that sufficient resources are available, and items are in usable condition
Report workplace hazards identified during the course of work to appropriate person according to standard operating procedures.
Ensures the safe disposal of waste materials in compliance with regulations
Ensures strict compliance with the principles of quarantine, and bio security in all Valley Park Farm operations.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Strong mechanical knowledge on a wide variety of equipment
Mechanical Maintenance Engineer trade qualification or equivalent
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Strong diagnostic abilities
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Honest, diligent and able to perform assigned duties to the best of your knowledge and abilities
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary from $95,000 per annum (incl Accommodation and Utility) + Super

result.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an IT Operations Engineer to join our National Operations Centre (NOC) team. We are seeking candidates with a strong background in IT systems and networks, coupled with extensive experience in managing IT service desk operations, and providing high-level support to internal and external staff. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in collaborating with various IT teams, ensuring the delivery of high-quality services to the business, while striving for operational excellence.

Please note this will be a permanent, full-time role based out of our Sydney CBD Office. It will involve participation in a continuous shift roster - working 4 days on and 4 days off. The shift patterns will be made up of 2-day shifts from 7am-7pm and 2-night shifts from 7pm-7am. 

Some of your responsibilities will include and are not limited to
•	Monitoring critical business services and systems, networks and infrastructure
•	Provide after-hours service desk support to users
•	Identify and address issues before they affect business operations
•	Handle and administer privileged accounts securely

What you’ll have done
•	Seasoned service desk analyst, NOC or equivalent experience (minimum 2 years), ideally in a continuous shift operations centre (24/7x365)
•	Strong technical knowledge of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, and other networking protocols
•	Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues quickly, including experience with major incidents
•	Familiarity with server operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and basic server administration
•	Experience with technology service monitoring tools - systems, application, and networks such as Centreon, Solarwinds, PTRG desirable
•	Familiarity with IT service management tools and frameworks (ITIL v3/4)
•	Demonstrated experience in delivering exemplary support, customer service and training
•	Excellent documentation skills for keeping records of issues, resolutions, and operational procedures
•	Effective communication with the ability to work as part of a team, especially in a high-pressure environment where collaboration is essential to solving issues

What we can offer you
•	5 weeks annual leave 
•	Annual salary between 90,000 - 95,000
•	Opportunities to progress within I-MED’s continued growth and expansion 
•	Being part of a team that makes a difference to the functioning of our ever-growing business 
•	Experience in communicating with different areas of IT 
•	Enjoy exclusive benefits including discounted private health insurance, salary packaging, Fitness Passport access, lifestyle and travel discounts, I-MED services for your family and employee wellbeing support.

About Us
At I-MED, we're more than just a medical imaging provider - we're a community of passionate professionals committed to excellence for our patients. With over 200 clinics and a staggering 6 million patient procedures annually, we proudly stand as one of the largest providers of medical imaging in the world. Our success lies in our people with over 350 dedicated doctors and 4,000 staff members who actively share clinical knowledge and expertise. 

If you're looking for the next step in your career and are passionate about the delivery of excellence within healthcare services, apply today!
